_comment: Step 1 placeholder recipes: one pipeline for everything made or done (GAMEPLAY_DESIGN.md §2; D110). inputs: an item or a tag with a count; tools: tags something in the pack must carry (not used up); station: a tag of a placed object within reach that must be working (a lit fire); seconds: how long it takes; outputs: items made; places: an object put into the world instead.

recipes.name: Rough fishing rod
recipes.description: A branch and a line twisted from plant fibre (E on grass).

recipes.name: Berry bait
recipes.description: Berries mashed into three baits (fish need bait to bite).

recipes.name: Stone knife
recipes.description: A stone flaked to an edge, bound into a split branch. Butchers game quickly.

recipes.name: Hunting spear
recipes.description: A straight pole with a stone point lashed on.

recipes.name: Rough bow
recipes.description: A springy stave, bent and strung with twisted fibre.

recipes.name: Arrows (5)
recipes.description: Five straight shoots with knapped stone tips.

recipes.name: Bone arrows (5)
recipes.description: Five arrows tipped with sharpened bone.

recipes.name: Stone-edged sword
recipes.description: A hardwood blade split from a log, its edges set with sharp stone flakes.

_comment_objects: Behaviour of placed objects; the campfire and the lean-to are built as pieces now (gameplay_pieces.json, D121).
